changes.summary: Printing a note no longer crashes, and prints the same pages Export to PDF makes
Adding a PDF to a note no longer crashes Parc
Note previews show spaces, ampersands and other characters instead of codes like
Pasting into a block's link field fills the field, pasted image, video and audio links can become media blocks, and pasting a link onto an empty media block fills it
YouTube and other player embeds in notes play instead of showing Error 153
A link copied from any app or web page pastes as a link, not plain text
Bookmarks stop refetching in a loop, web videos and sounds that fail to load offer Try again, and empty media blocks take dropped links and images
Deleting a property while its value is being typed no longer beeps or writes that text into another property
Images dragged from a web page into a note land as images instead of links
Return in a property's menu now does the row picked with the arrow keys, such as Delete Property or a type
New notes and Easels, and notes or Easels opened from a split pane's address bar, now open in that pane instead of a new tab
Note previews skip synced-block markers and other hidden comments and show the note's words
Web links in notes open in a Peek, following your Settings → Links choices for other-site links and Shift-click
Notes without their own icon show the Library's note mark in the sidebar, tab switcher, command bar and note links
The @, slash, [[ and emoji menus come back when you edit after the trigger again, such as backspacing to a bare @, while Escape keeps them closed for that trigger
Reminders play the notification sound when they go off
Date and reminder suggestions show their weekday and date, times without am or pm offer both readings, and passed reminders say Already passed
Markdown exports and Copy as Markdown write plain, portable Markdown, with synced blocks as their content and no hidden Parc markup
Drawing in an Easel no longer crashes Parc when you finish a stroke
Easels opened in a split pane showing a page sit on top of it like notes, so Back returns to the page as it was and Forward to the Easel
The date picker's reminder line and reminder notifications name days by weekday and date, and notifications say Today or Tomorrow as of when they ring
Easels wear the Notes look, with the Space theme behind Notes paper and ink, text, selection and controls that stay readable in dark mode
Easel web items wear the Notes embed header, with a clear Snapshot or Live label, a Make live button that is always there for captured regions, and Back to snapshot
Notes and Easels opened over a page stack like web history, so Back walks through every one to the page and Forward retraces them
Selecting a capture region at the window's edges no longer moves the window, and the hidden sidebar stays put while capturing
Captures can be sent to a new or recent note, landing as an image that remembers its page for Make Live
Live element captures show just the captured element, never the whole page, and go back to the snapshot with a clear note when the page can't line up
Put an Easel in a note with /easel or a pasted Easel link, and edit its live canvas right there at the width and height you drag
Put an Easel in a note with /easel or a pasted Easel link, and edit its live canvas right there at the width and height you drag
Easels without their own icon show the Library's Easel mark in the sidebar, tab switcher, command bar, history and note blocks
Captured images in notes show their page with a Snapshot label, and Make live shows the same region from the live page with Back to snapshot
Tab hops right over an Easel in a note until you click into it, so the keyboard never gets lost on the canvas
Easel text with damaged font settings no longer crashes Parc when it is shown
One damaged Easel file no longer hides every other Easel from the Library, pickers and command bar
Easels with repeated object IDs open with those objects re-IDed, and the canvas, live pages and drag guides no longer crash on them
Hovering a note or Easel tab shows a preview card with a picture of the page or canvas, Copy Link and Open in Split View
Live captures from sites that scroll inside a panel now scroll that panel back into place too, instead of giving up and staying a snapshot
Drag an Easel from the sidebar onto a note's text and it lands as an Easel block right where the drop line shows
Turn an Easel into vector SVG and a self-contained HTML page with its fonts, images, links and both light and dark ink
Give Easels the Notes page menu with Copy Link, Copy as Image, Image, HTML and PDF export, Show in Library, Duplicate and Delete
Live captures in notes line up regions from sites that scroll inside a panel, just like Easels do
Webpages and live captures on an Easel inside a note are real live pages now, with Make live and Back to snapshot right there
Show in Library on an Easel or note now opens Easels & Notes with that card selected, scrolled into view and searched clear
The capture palette tidies up into a Notes-style menu with Easel and Note submenus, one highlight and search that finds every action and document
Capture mode gets a bar with Element, Region, Visible Area and Full Page a click or a letter away, plus a size readout and an accent outline, so Visible Area stops playing hide-and-seek
Frame in Portrait Mode opens right inside the capture palette, with picture tiles, a big live preview on the capture itself and an Apply button that only lights up when there's something to apply
The Portrait Frame page answers Return from its color slider, keeps Cancel and Apply in view in narrow split panes and says Back like every other back button
The capture palette opens with Save to Library highlighted again, so one Return right after a capture saves it
Pages you open after a note or Easel now join the same history, so Back and Forward weave through pages and documents in the order you went
Closing note Find, media zoom or the PDF viewer only hands focus back to a view that is still visible in that window
Teach equation macros TeX's sneakier tricks: delimited \def parameters, \expandafter, \noexpand, \csname, and cells that keep their definitions to themselves
Teach tabs to remember a note opened over a page, so Back and Forward can hop between them
Chemistry speaks the rest of mhchem: every \bond flavour, radical dots, italic variables, upright braces, and \pu with comma decimals, written-out powers of ten and ranges
Emoji and CJK in equation scripts borrow a properly shrunk system font instead of wobbling off the baseline
Open a page's Markdown links right in its tab, with Back returning to the page just as you left it and Forward hopping back to the note
Live embeds in notes take your very first click and let scrolls spill into the note once the page runs out of road
Equations number themselves across the whole note, and \label, \eqref and \ref link up so a click jumps to the right one
Escape hops out of a live embed back to your note, and retired notes now tuck their pages in for good
Read-only locked notes stop dangling a dud Unlock button, ⌘↩ opens page links even when locked, and Redo finally admits it's ⇧⌘Z
Swipe forward from a page right into the note you just left, and ⌘-click Forward to pop that note open in a background tab
A live embed in a split pane you weren't using still takes your very first click
Underscores and stars right after an emoji italicize again instead of mistaking half an emoji for a word
Selections respect their field, IME never eats keys, and Replace All stops fibbing about its count
Moving blocks to another note is one honest action now: undo from either note puts them back, and unrelated undos stop raiding the other note
Swipe back off a note to its page, hold Back or Forward to see the note in the list, and ⌘-click Back to fork the page behind it into a new tab
Tab icons notice swapped pictures and closed notes, and imports chase notes that wander off mid-copy
Nest blocks under any text, like Notion, saved as tidy ::: indent fences that read fine on GitHub

Equations learn KaTeX's size dial, raisebox, smash, substack, genfrac, colour boxes, clickable \href and \url links and over/undergroups, and mhchem's dashed bonds finally draw like KaTeX instead of a dash pileup
Typing over a vanished block selection lands in the nearest text instead of the void
Note links now say exactly how they were clicked, and target=_blank ones skip the raw-text detour
Equations learn alignat, multline, subarray, dcases, darray, starred matrices and dashed array lines, numbering right along with the rest of the note
A note that moves mid-import takes its picture along instead of leaving a twin in the old Attachments
Moved blocks stay findable even after the other note closes and reopens, and a redo that can't reach it leaves them home
Keep the emoji grid's last column out from under the scroller, with matching margins on both sides
Exported equations keep counting across the note, and their references link straight to the labelled one, while open drafts renumber everything live
Commutative diagrams arrive: \begin{CD} draws @>>>, @<<<, @VVV, @AAA, @= and @| arrows with labels riding above, below and beside them
Equations pick up the rest of KaTeX's symbol zoo, mathtools colons, \char, \verb, \mathchoice, \vcenter, \pmb, the TeX logos and the dd/cc/sp units nobody remembers
Undo a move in one note and Redo works from the other, since both notes now share the same step instead of one starting fresh
Equations stretch \utilde, \Overrightarrow, harpoons and line segments over anything, draw \phase and actuarial \angl, and two-headed and long-equals x-arrows finally grow with their labels
Tabs forked from the page behind a note now line up after their source, and picking from the note's history list refreshes the page like the usual list
\text grows up with accents, nested bold and italics, colours, sizes, links, \(…\) math and proper curly quotes and dashes
Physicists get \bra, \ket, \braket and friends, and set-builder \set and \Set put the bar where it belongs
Mermaid joins the language list with highlighting, remembers Code, Preview or Split in invisible metadata, and HTML exports can carry the drawings in light and dark
Heading 4 and Toggle heading 4 join the slash menu (/h4, /####) and every Turn into list, and the table of contents now lists H4s too
Keep the Mermaid view mode beside the block model so every windowless notes test builds again
Typing ->, <-, <->, =>, >=, <= or -- turns into proper arrows, comparisons and an em dash, never in code or equations, and one ⌘Z brings back exactly what you typed
Photo credits ride along with images and covers, saved quietly in the note and shown with links in HTML and PDF exports
Notes remember inline PDFs with their size, alignment and caption, plain-text notes keep them as file references, and HTML exports show them in place
Select a few blocks and Turn into 2 to 5 columns lays them out side by side, from the block menu, the format bar or the keyboard
Drop the duplicate Mermaid view enum so the block model's copy is the only one
Custom emoji get a Markdown home, so :name: shortcodes read, write and export to HTML as little images while escaped ones stay text
Notes read and write synced blocks as invisible comment markers, so the file still reads like plain Markdown on GitHub
Images remember a crop and a shape in the note's Markdown, and HTML exports draw both
Mermaid code blocks draw live diagrams with Code, Preview and Split views, crossfading between them and keeping the last good drawing when the diagram breaks
The block menu gets a View submenu for Mermaid diagrams, so Code, Preview and Split are a right-click away
Date mentions take ranges like @Jan 3 → Jan 5 or @Jan 3 - 5, remember their end, reminder lead, time zone and format in the file, and Jan 3 typed in November means the coming one
HTML exports embed Mermaid diagrams as SVG for light and dark, and PDF exports wait for the drawings and print them as crisp vectors
Image blocks and the cover picker get an Unsplash tab to search free photos, save the pick into Attachments and credit the photographer under it
Notes keep a live index of every note that links or mentions them, and renaming or moving a note rewrites those links so nothing breaks
Rename the Unsplash thumbnail's picture so it stops clashing with the button's own image
Spell out the Unsplash tile's photographer link so it builds cleanly
Tables keep merged cells and cell colours in the file, export them as real colspan and rowspan, and read merges back from pasted HTML
Notes show how many notes link to them under the title, with a popup or an inline list of each linking note and the sentence around the link, and the page menu picks Expanded, Show in Popup or Off
PDFs read right in the note, from /pdf, a dropped file or a pasted link, with scrolling pages, a page indicator, zoom, full screen, download, resizing and password unlock

The date picker gets an End date toggle with a range band on the calendar, Format and Time zone pages, a full Remind list, reminders turn red the day they're due, and relative dates redraw themselves as days pass
Make your own emoji with the picker's plus button, then use them inline with :name:, as page and callout icons, and rename or delete them, all saved in the notes folder
Notes renamed or moved in Finder keep their backlinks and links to them follow, and a rename never makes the backlink count blink
Synced blocks stay live across notes: edit any copy and the original and every other copy follow, undo works from either side, and copies find originals that moved
Crop images with a draggable frame, clip them to circles, hearts and six other shapes, and give them alt text with an ALT badge, all from the image's ••• menu
Wrap the synced-note search in parentheses so the guard parses
/bread adds a breadcrumb that shows where the note lives, keeps up when it moves or gets renamed, and opens any folder on the path in Easels & Notes
Merge and unmerge table cells and colour them from a cell's ••• menu, fill down with ⌘D and right with ⌘R, and drag a table's corner to add or drop rows and columns
Keep the custom emoji picker pieces self-contained so the picker's windowless checks build them too
The crop bar swaps to icons cleanly on narrow pages, and VoiceOver's grow and shrink keep the crop inside the picture

Button blocks: /button makes a pill that adds blocks below, above, at the top or bottom of the note, asks first or opens a note or link, saved as GitHub-friendly details and undone one press at a time
Button heights measure off the main actor so the canvas estimate compiles

The button's gear opens its editor: name and emoji, a list of actions to add, reorder or delete, and the blocks it inserts edited right there with the full note editor, every change saved as you go and undone as one step
Make synced blocks from the block menu or /synced, copy them anywhere, and see where else they live from a border that lights up while you edit
Synced blocks dropped from another note stay live, and dropping one inside another unwraps it instead of nesting
Editing a button's blocks never touches the note's date reminders, and closing the editor stops its timers
Synced copies stay live while the original's note is closed, which quietly opens in the background and lets go when you're done
Give the synced block's header controls their own property names so they stop colliding with the button's
Backspace at the start of a synced block selects it instead of spilling its lines out, and joins lines inside like anywhere else
Typing in notes without synced blocks skips the synced bookkeeping, and the border stops rescanning the page on every keystroke
Copies in closed notes catch up a couple of seconds after the original changes, so their files read right on GitHub too
Clearing out a synced block leaves one empty line to type in, everywhere it's synced and in the same undo step
Look for the Original Again really searches again, even in notes it already checked
Parc claims Markdown and text files as a default editor, so they open in Parc unless you've picked another app
Releases carry the Unsplash key from the packager's keychain, so the Unsplash tab works without a key in the repo
Mermaid treats Windows line endings like any other, and the button, emoji, image menu and diagram test suites build and pass again
Pick where new notes live in Settings, like downloads
Put Parc on Finder's Open With list for Markdown and text files, so they open as notes you can actually edit
Draw dividers, and a table of contents that keeps up with your headings and waves at the one you jump to
Give every Notes menu a real Parc card that pops open, glides its highlight and tucks itself away
Hover any block to find a + and a grip waiting in the margin, ready to add a line or pick the block up
Hand Notes squishy toolbar buttons, chips, Parc keycaps and a search field that filters menus as you type
Typeset equations natively in STIX Two Math, with brackets that grow, limits that stack and matrices that line up
Pick emoji from a bouncy grid with search, skin tones, recents and a Random button for the indecisive
Give code blocks live colours, a language picker, Wrap and a Copy that says thanks, and let equations and leftover Markdown look the part
Label arrows with \xrightarrow, cross things out with \cancel and write \R for the reals in equations
Colour code blocks by kind in Parc's palette and keep inline code sitting on the same line as its words
Find and replace inside a note, with every match glowing, ⌘G to hop between them and Replace All as one tidy undo
Lay pages out like a proper editor, with columns you can drag wider, callouts that hug their kids and blocks that glide into place
Keep typed code in Space Mono with its tab stops, let Cmd-Return leave a code block, and tint the exact TeX typo
Give equation scripts their proper small-print glyphs and flatten accents on tall letters instead of just shrinking everything
Hand a block its new text before measuring it, so a merged line gets the room it needs right away
Teach equations your own \newcommand shortcuts and write chemistry with \ce and \pu, arrows, charges, isotopes and all
Drag a selection across blocks, rubber-band whole blocks from the margin and arrow between them like they were one page
Number display equations with \tag, \tag* and auto-numbered align, gather and equation, tags hugging the right edge
Find notes in the command bar by what's written inside them, not just their names
Click a block's grip for a searchable menu of everything it can do, or drag it anywhere, even into columns, with the page scrolling along
Drop Markdown and text files on the sidebar to open them as notes
Type like it's Notion, with Markdown shortcuts that become blocks, rounded code and highlight pills, live inline math, mention pills and to-dos that pop when you tick them
Dress pages up with a cover, a big emoji icon, a title that renames the file, properties and a time machine for older versions
Let code blocks say "Write some code" when empty, keep Markdown shortcuts out of code, and tuck an empty caption away when you leave it
Add tables you can Tab through, drag wider, shuffle by their grips and fill straight from a spreadsheet paste
Highlight some text and a toolbar floats up to bold it, link it, paint it or turn it into a heading, plus a hover card for every link
Copy, cut and paste in text blocks through the Notes clipboard, so blocks, links and Markdown travel intact
Give properties tidy dates and tags that only show their little x on hover, and let the find bar's chevron flip without fighting the press bounce
Tuck fonts, small text, full width, lock, copy, export, history and the trash into a page menu that counts your words
Copy notes as rich text that Mail, Pages and Docs understand, and paste web pages and docs back in as real blocks
Type / for every block with a peek at each, @ for notes, dates and reminders, and :smile: for emoji
Click a date or reminder in your text to change it in the date picker
Give notes real images, videos, sounds, files, bookmarks and note links that shimmer in, resize on a spring and zoom when you double-click
Pop the math editor open the moment / adds an inline equation, and let a click back in the text close the emoji picker
List your Notes folder in the Library with emoji, a peek at the text and when you last touched it, plus Show in Finder and Move to Trash
Let the command bar find words inside notes you have open, even ones saved outside your Notes folder
Pin a page menu to every note's top corner, let Print and every Find command reach notes, and keep ⌘⇧H on your last colour instead of a surprise Heading 1
Click a note reminder and Parc opens that note for you, in a regular window and never a private one
Copy a link to any block with ⌃⌘L, peek at media with Space, and drag callouts around with their real boxes on
Drag Markdown or text files onto the sidebar and the insertion line shows where they'll land, then they open right there
Open a note link with a #heading or block anchor from Finder, a page, a reminder or another note and Parc scrolls straight to that spot
Open the find bar just under the page menu button so the two stop playing Tetris in the corner
Stop reminders from nagging about notes you already sent to the Trash
Give GitHub and Obsidian alert callouts their proper emoji and colour without scribbling defaults into the file
Keep your selection a soft Parc purple when the window steps away, and teach text to line up left, centre or right on its own
Let code sit snug in its box, with language, caption, wrap and copy floating in only when you hover
Find now lights up titles, captions and table cells, the title tucks in under its icon, rename slip-ups show right below it, and → steps into an equation to edit it
Lift dragged blocks as a crisp full-size ghost on Retina screens instead of a shrunken copy in the corner
Paint tip, warning, caution and friends' callout boxes in their alert colours unless you pick one yourself
Give Small Text, Full Width and Lock Page real little switches in the page menu so you can see what's on at a glance
Open a page's Markdown links straight into a note tab, leaving the page and its back button right where you left them
Keep property tags, page menus, find and cover pickers readable the moment your Space flips between light and dark
Stretch tables to the same right edge as everything else, with the add-column bar peeking in from outside on hover
Embeds now hold a real live page right in your note, sign-ins and all, with a tidy header and a handle to make it taller
Give live embeds a Caption button in their header, so a page can still get a little footnote
Let the Library and command bar notice when the note index wakes up, so your first body search actually finds things
Keep big tables from crashing when undo or a delete pulls a row out from under the cursor, and keep tab-indented code in one cell
Make drops beside a block and links pasted over a selection undo in one go, and refuse to open javascript, vbscript and data links
Guess an embed's height from its real size so the page stops jumping when one scrolls in, and retire the old bookmark-style embed
Drop in a giant video or an iCloud file and keep typing, it shimmers in while the copy happens behind the scenes
Let ⌘F, ⌘G and friends search the live page you're clicked into instead of the note wrapped around it
Export to PDF prints the real page with its cover, icon, colours and page breaks between blocks, and HTML exports typeset your equations
Make menu picks swallow the whole query, close on a click away, and let reminders follow notes through renames, moves and the trash
Copying a note as rich text never phones home for pictures, it just writes their alt text instead
Turn away javascript: and data: links, stop the fading toolbar from formatting old selections, and tidy up after image menus and audio players
Stop /tog from dragging Link to note along, so the slash menu only shows near-misses when nothing really matches
Tuck blocks inside a GitHub-style tip or warning in past its icon, even when the icon comes free with the alert
Give every note one tab and one save brain, however you spell its path, so Plan.md, plan.md and that symlinked folder stop fighting over the same file
Show hand-written GitHub NOTE alerts in blue with their ℹ️, while Parc's own plain callouts stay plain after a reload
Print the real page with its cover, colours and all, and show rename slip-ups right under the title where they stick around long enough to read
Notes never save a placeholder mid-copy anymore, so quitting early still leaves a link that works, and Replace and cover uploads copy in the background too
Hang on to unsaved words when a file vanishes, moves or won't save, answer other apps' save requests without stalling, and spot renamed folders with dots in their names
Stop calling every note an Easel in the sidebar's address pill, so Plan.md finally gets to be Plan.md
Give note tabs their own emoji instead of a generic page glyph, in the sidebar, Favorites, the switcher and the command bar
Make Put It Back actually put a vanished note back, folders and all, even when nothing was unsaved, and say so when something else took its spot
Scan big notes folders in the background, so the Library and command bar show names right away and stop freezing while 20,000 files get a once-over

Saving a note never quietly changes what it means, so a divider up top stays a divider, a [x] before a line break stays text, and stray HTML under a link definition, callout title or empty tag stays exactly where you left it
Polish the Notes wording so menus, toasts and errors say exactly what happens, and save block downloads to your Space's download folder
Hook the Put It Back button up to the thing that actually puts it back
Curl the last stray apostrophes in media and cover errors, and name the conflict undo after the button you pressed
Put Parc on Finder's Open With list for the PDFs, pictures, text, music and videos it can already show, and name a local file's tab after the file while it loads
Find pages you've visited in Parc straight from Spotlight, like Safari, with deleted history leaving Spotlight too
Teach Split This Pane to start a Split View on a lone page instead of just shrugging
Let Shift-click Peek catch pages that sites pop open themselves, so dashboard tiles stop sneaking off into new windows
Round up the Shift-click strays, so PDF links, search forms and pages sites open themselves land in a Peek, or the Peek you're in, instead of new windows
Let Shift-clicked forms keep their paperwork, so sign-ins and app launches that post data open in a Peek, or the Peek you're in, with everything they sent
Sweep the last Google-only and do-nothing rows out of More Settings, and teach Reset to keep its settings report to itself
Stop wearing Chrome's brand badge, show Enhanced protection only to people already on it, hush its warning-page upsell, and tuck away Live Caption, which never heard a word
Stop sharing Chrome's install-tracking drawer, and take the do-nothing Live Caption switches out of the media popup and picture in picture
Let videos and calls keep their seat while half the window still peeks out, and hop into picture in picture once another app or Parc window swallows the rest, even if it creeps over later
Let videos in a Parc window that never had focus stay put while you can plainly see them, instead of bolting into picture in picture the moment they start
Give split panes bunk beds, stacking a new page below or beside any pane from its menu or Control-Shift-Backslash
Let a tab or link dropped near a pane's top or bottom edge, or its sides in a top-and-bottom split, bunk right there with it while the panes scoot over to save its seat
Give More Settings a spring clean, tucking away the switches that do nothing in Parc or only work with a Google account
Put Parc's P on every Chromium page Parc opens, dark mode included, so Settings, its About page and the version page stop moonlighting as Chromium
Make a cancelled Restart truly stand down, so your next Quit just quits instead of sneaking Parc back open
Let the divider between top and bottom panes snap to the middle from either direction, and only when you ease into it, instead of grabbing everything from above
Squeeze split panes into a cramped window instead of shoving the end ones off the page, with drop previews and drag cards that match where a new pane really lands
Teach drop previews some patience, so a tab or link flying across a split stops shoving panes around for every spot it passes on the way
Let the Library's menu items glide out one after another instead of sprinting past you
Let "github" plus Space be a plain old search instead of teleporting you into GitHub's own search box, while Tab still takes you there
Show the twenty websites cosplaying as search engines out of the search engine menu, and let Tab search LinkedIn and Wikipedia right from their own pages
Let extension popups wait until they're drawn, then glide in softly and drift off when closed, instead of blinking in half-ready and vanishing
Fill in just the website when you type part of its address, instead of the clingy sign-in page it forwards you to every day
Hang extension popups just below the button you clicked, whether it's in the sidebar, a toolbar or either half of a stacked split, instead of parking them on top of it or over the other pane
Let the bar remember what you actually pick, so typing "okta" stops playing dumb and leads with the page you always choose
Trim long result links down to the site and path, light up the bits you typed, and fold repeat sign-in pages into one row instead of a wall of login parameters
Keep what you're typing in view while a long completion trails off softly to the right, with the page's title tagging along in grey
Let extension popups stretch and tuck in smoothly when their contents grow or shrink, instead of hiccuping to the new size in one go
Type a few words from any page's title and the bar sniffs it out of your open tabs, your archive or last month's browsing, and archived tabs hop straight back in when you pick them
Let the Library's side tiles take a breath when you click them, with icons that hop at an easy amble, highlights that glide in and out, and pages that fade in instead of slamming the door
Light up the extension button you clicked and give its icon a little Dock-style hop until the popup shows up, so slow popups stop pretending they didn't hear you

Let Tab borrow a site's own search right on pages like GitLab, march site-search defaults back to Google, and teach Parc to remember the site searches you binned while quietly restocking the ones it fumbled
Keep the Media grid in two tidy columns however you reopen the Library, and stop thumbnails from ghosting into blank tiles when you hop between Library pages and back
Teach pinned extension buttons in page toolbars to glow exactly as bright as the Site Control Center button beside them, so dark mode stops playing favourites
Let videos and calls stay put when you click into the app sharing your split screen, so picture in picture only pops out once Parc is mostly out of sight instead of the moment it blinks
Bring back the right-click menu in docked Developer Tools, so Edit attribute, Copy, Store as global variable and the rest show up instead of a click that does nothing
Open View certificate from the Security and Network panels for every origin, and in undocked Developer Tools, instead of doing nothing unless it was the page's own certificate
Right-click now works in extension pop-ups, extension side panels, embedded extension options and the undocked device toolbar, with Inspect, Copy and Paste, instead of doing nothing

Let Puppeteer, Playwright and ChromeDriver drive their own isolated Parc profile from --user-data-dir, find DevToolsActivePort where they expect it and skip onboarding with --no-first-run, instead of silently using your real profile
Open file choosers from extension pop-ups and side panels instead of silently cancelling them, and keep the pop-up open while you pick
Open DevTools on DevTools with Command-Option-I in an undocked tools window, title each tools window after its page, and enable Full Screen and Close Window there
Show the download arrival in the inspected page's window for screenshots, traces and other files saved from Developer Tools, instead of no sign anything happened
Let Save as PDF work when an embedded page such as extension options prints, instead of the save panel doing nothing
Open the downloaded disk image as Parc's install window for real this time, now that Finder can read the map, with each park sign planted on its own little grassy knoll instead of in the sea
Make View's Zoom In, Zoom Out and Actual Size zoom an undocked Developer Tools window instead of being greyed out
Confirm folder uploads from extension pop-ups and side panels on their own window instead of refusing them or floating a loose dialog
Open links, Learn more and Open in new tab from service worker, shared worker, extension and Node Developer Tools in a front tab instead of doing nothing
Warn on every page when an extension starts debugging the browser, in a Parc strip with Cancel and close that stop it, instead of letting it debug silently
Put the debugging warning's buttons in the Tab order as soon as it appears, let pane focus reach it and announce it once when a background tab with one is shown
Attach Chromium's prompts, such as DevTools' Allow edit files for Workspaces and Local Overrides and the file pickers' folder warnings, to their page or window instead of floating loose mid-screen
